data.name: Home_Intro_Subtitle
data.value: A community-driven role-playing tool designed for live sessions.

data.name: Home_Intro_Paragraph1
data.value: Rollocracy is a tool developed by Lunelian for Community Roleplaying: a Game Master (streamer) can run a session for hundreds of players at once! Each player has their own character they can customize, perform rolls with, vote to influence the course of the session, and more.

data.name: Home_Intro_Paragraph2
data.value: The game system is highly customizable, and entirely optional: want something simple with 4 attributes? Totally doable! Prefer something more complex with advanced skills, a wide variety of classes or species, and talents automatically assigned at character creation? That works too!

data.name: Home_Intro_FeatureList3
data.value: Rolls, polls, mass distribution, random draws, logs...

data.name: Home_Intro_FeatureList4
data.value: Option to undo consequences in case of mistakes

data.name: Home_Intro_FeatureList5
data.value: Special roles for certain players (Observer, Assistant)

data.name: Home_Intro_SupportRollocracy
data.value: If you'd like to support the project (help cover server costs and pay for childcare while I code instead of taking care of my kids), you can! 🥰

data.name: Home_Intro_LoggedIn
data.value: You are logged in. You can join a session or access your account settings.

data.name: Home_Thanks_Subtitle
data.value: A few important acknowledgements around the project.

data.name: Home_Thanks_Paragraph1
data.value: If Rollocracy exists today, it's mainly because others paved the way!

data.name: Home_Thanks_TonyTruand
data.value: A huge thank you to TonyTruand, developer of MosaRPG, which inspired Rollocracy. I personally used his "little site" for two years before wanting to build my own solution, better suited to my GMing style. 🥨

data.name: Home_Thanks_FibreTigre
data.value: Original idea of MosaRPG by FibreTigre.

data.name: Home_Thanks_Paragraph2
data.value: Special thanks to Silkinael (SilkinaelTV) and the other streamers I played Community RPG with, who made it possible for me to keep doing it (Lubuwei, Siha, Phouille, Arzilia, ForceGhostProduction). Also a shoutout to Shaunz, who got me into this in the first place. And of course, every bit of feedback, bug report, and new idea to improve the tool is always welcome!
